rules.accepted_credit_types: Pharmacotherapeutics CE in the APRN area of certification; the 2 mandatory hours are Board courses linked via CE Broker
rules.alternatives: APRN licensure requires current national certification in the area of certification plus an active Arkansas or multistate RN license; the RN CE (15 hours) can itself be met by national certification/recertification.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; certificates for the 24 months before renewal must be produced within 30 days.

topics.who: APRNs with prescriptive authority (professional boundaries and Arkansas APRN prescribing rules and laws; part of the 5 hours)

rules.notes: The 5 pharmacotherapeutics hours apply only with prescriptive authority and come on top of the RN requirement (15 contact hours, certification or a college course). Reactivating prescriptive authority: extra 5 hours per 12 months of non-prescribing.
rules.rule_quote: (2) Effective January 1, 2010, APRNs with prescriptive authority shall complete five (5) contact hours of pharmacotherapeutics continuing education in the APRN’s area of certification each biennium prior to license renewal.
